§6Foundry Mold§f

§aTells the basin what shape to pour. Ingot, plate, block, or something weirder.§f

Craft a §bBlank Mold§f at the anvil (firebrick + iron ingot), then combine it with a sample item to get the specific mold you want. Pop it into a foundry basin, pour molten metal from the crucible through channels, and extract the finished casting.

Molds are reusable. Check JEI for the full list: ingots, plates, wires, dense wires, blades, pipes, weapon parts, and more. The shallow basin takes 5 molds, the full basin takes 9.

§ePS:§f Some molds produce multiple items per pour (wires x8, ingots x9 in the full basin).
